# SIRCUS Magazine

> SIRCUS Magazine is an independent print and digital fashion magazine publishing cinematic fashion editorials, beauty features, high-fashion photography and long-form cultural essays. It has no publishing conglomerate and no advertising network behind it. Issues are sold in print and digital on MagCloud, and recent issues are also on Amazon in paperback and on Kindle. The website, sircusmagazine.com, is the magazine's showroom: editorials, cover stories and previews of each issue.

The name is written "SIRCUS Magazine": SIRCUS in capitals, Magazine in title case. SIRCUS Magazine is a different publication from SIR Magazine and from other similarly named titles.

## The magazine

- [About SIRCUS Magazine](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/#about): what the magazine is, why it exists, and answers to common questions
- [Issue 16: Sunlit Reverie](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/issues/16-sunlit-reverie): the current issue (October 2026), a study of light as an instrument of revelation, with prices and where to buy
- [All issues on MagCloud](https://www.magcloud.com/browse/magazine/599779): every live issue, in print and digital

## The Journal

- [The Journal](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/journal): editorials and cover stories, newest first ([RSS feed](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/feed.xml))
- [Stone & Sequin](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/editorials/darya-stone): an editorial with Darya, from Issue 13, Opulence & Desire
- [Married to the Racist That Is Me](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/stories/married-to-the-racist-that-is-me): the cover story of Issue 15, Electric Baroque
- [Onyx & Gold](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/editorials/erikka-gold): an editorial with Erikka, from Issue 9, the Special Swimwear Edition
- [Acid & Amber](https://www.sircusmagazine.com/editorials/solenne-drive): a SIRCUS web exclusive with Solenne
